theme_strategy: Clean minimal light with dark mode option (Swiss & High-Contrast Archetype)

headings.usage: Dates, application title, major section headers. Use tracking-tight.

body_ui.usage: Navigation, buttons, tooltips, settings, login forms.

editor.usage: The actual todo lists, backlog items, markdown tags. Gives it the 'plain text editor' feel.

rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint greys slightly.
Use high contrast for active states. Checkboxes when checked should be inverted or faded out completely with line-through.

desktop.main_editor: col-span-8 lg:col-span-9 h-full overflow-y-auto px-12 py-16
desktop.backlog_panel: col-span-4 lg:col-span-3 h-full overflow-y-auto border-l border-border bg-surface/50 px-8 py-16

mobile.backlog_panel: Fixed bottom sheet or drawer accessed via Floating Action Button or bottom nav. Do not show side-by-side on mobile.

general: Remove App-logo-spin and default text-align: center from App.css.
Use optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Padding must be generous. Editor canvas should feel like a blank piece of paper.

Header_Nav.style: Solid Background with a hard bottom border (border-b border-border). Height 64px. Minimal elements: Logo on left, Theme toggle & User profile on right.
Header_Nav.behavior: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-background. DO NOT use complete transparent background in header.

Editor_Canvas.style: Typography must be JetBrains Mono. Dates as H2 (text-2xl tracking-tight mb-8 font-cabinet).
Editor_Canvas.behavior: Toggle between rich interactive (clickable Shadcn checkboxes + text) and markdown plain-text (<textarea> with monospace font). Transition opacity 0.2s ease.

Todo_Item.style: Flex row, items-start, gap-4 group. Custom animated checkbox. Text color should fade to muted and get line-through when checked.
Todo_Item.interaction: Hover state: reveal 'move to backlog' or 'drag' icon (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100). Focus states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:outline-none.

Backlog_Item.style: Smaller typography (text-sm). Compact padding (py-2). Border-b border-border/50.

Buttons.style: Sharp rectangular (rounded-none) for a brutalist edge.
Buttons.interaction: Hover: bg-accent/90 text-accent-foreground transform -translate-y-[1px] shadow-sm transition-all.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders. No heavy shadows. No glassmorphism (reduces legibility in text editors).
visual_enhancers.motion: Use Framer Motion for smooth task list reordering and checking off tasks (strikethrough animation).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react (default) with 1.5px stroke width for a sharp, technical look.

accessibility: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='todo-checkbox', data-testid='theme-toggle').
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-foreground).

auth_page_images.description: Minimalist black monitor on white desk. Use as a half-screen hero image on the Auth/Login page to convey 'focus' and 'clean workspace'.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx files, so write all React components using .jsx/.js extensions.
Delete standard React boilerplate in App.css (remove text-align: center, App-header).
Configure Tailwind spacing to be generous (use p-8, p-12 where you would normally use p-4).
Implement the 'Swiss High-Contrast' palette: rely on monochrome borders and text colors. Avoid generic blue/indigo defaults.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for the Todo items; make them seamless rows in the canvas.
For the Markdown/Rich Text toggle, ensure state transitions are smooth and don't cause layout jumps.
Integrate the imported fonts in index.css and apply them via Tailwind config (font-cabinet, font-mono, font-sans).
Ensure PWA manifest and service worker setup is complete as per user request.
Ensure DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (not on the main text editor to maintain legibility).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar.
